close_reason: Decision B (re-scope to format-agnostic). PKIX-amgn.8 retitled to 'vendor zlint catalog metadata for pkix-lint-cabf (output format TBD)'. .8.3+ blocked on policy-data format decision. Applied under PKIX-ncab.7.
description:
PKIX-amgn.8 is a sub-epic of PKIX-amgn whose purpose is to extract zlint NDJSON and emit OSCAL Catalog JSON consumed by pkix-lint-cabf. Closed children .8.1 (zlint binary install) and .8.2 (pkix-lint-cabf-refresh scaffold) shipped 2026-05-11. Open child .8.3+ (the actual NDJSON → OSCAL transform) has not started.

Without OSCAL centrality, decide:

- **A) Close-as-WONTFIX**; zlint metadata vendoring postponed until policy-data format is decided.
- **B) Re-scope** to format-agnostic "zlint metadata vendoring" (extract NDJSON, emit in some neutral form).
- **C) Split**: keep the metadata-extraction portion; mark the OSCAL emit portion as one optional output (still ships but not primary).

Linked decisions: .4 (pkix-lint-cabf-refresh crate fate).

Decision-gate bead. Human label inherited from parent.
title: Decide fate of PKIX-amgn.8 (epic 'vendor zlint catalog as OSCAL Catalog JSON')
